description: Story #1493 AC3 fixed, recorded query set for the temporal overfetch-ceiling recall comparison. Run via scripts/analysis/temporal_overfetch_1493_recall_compare.py against a repo built by scripts/analysis/temporal_overfetch_1493_build_fixture.py.

target_repo_fixture.shape: 20 real commits, two quarters (2024 Q1 and 2024 Q3, 10 commits each), six rotating topic files, EACH commit's diff sized (~1009-line full-file rewrite) so its aggregated per-commit document chunks into ~36 pieces (matching temporal_overfetch_1493_ac4_benchmark.py's 2.7% head-density ratio), real VoyageAI embeddings via `cidx index --index-commits` (measured: 612 total chunks, achieved_head_ratio=0.0327). Corrects the ORIGINAL fixture, which produced exactly 1 chunk/commit (100% head chunks) -- see build_fixture.py's module docstring for the full methodology-flaw history.
target_repo_fixture.sizing_rationale: Q1's real total is 252 chunks (6 pure-addition first-touch commits at ~18 chunks each + 4 modified commits at ~36 each) and Q3's is 360 chunks (all 10 modified) -- both exceed the AC1 combined-overfetch-ceiling's capped threshold for the worst-case query (true_user_limit=3 * TEMPORAL_COMBINED_OVERFETCH_CEILING=60 = 180), so the cap actually truncates real per-shard candidates rather than trivially returning everything regardless of cap value. Commit COUNT no longer needs to be large (520->20): realistic PER-COMMIT chunking density, not commit count, is what makes the corpus realistic -- see reports/perf/temporal_overfetch_1493_corpus_stats.json for the full per-commit measured breakdown.

queries.purpose: worst-case chunk_type (40x) across BOTH quarterly shards (multi-shard dispatch)
small limit amplifies the combined multiplier's absolute row count
commit_diff's real 'no is_head filtering' semantics (regression-guards the bug this story's own review caught and fixed)
no post-filters, all-time -> search_limit == limit exactly (AC1 cap is a byte-identical no-op here)
larger limit -- combined multiplier ratio unchanged but absolute overfetch volume larger
single-shard (2024Q1 only) case, per AC3's explicit single-shard requirement
report's documented absolute worst case: smallest limit x chunk_type=commit_message x multi-shard
